PART III - LANDS Title Registration REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998 Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No. 120 of Block 01, con-tained in the Cadastral Map No. 830070, situated in the Village of Gangasiripura, within the Grama Niladhari Division of No.04 - Gan-gasiripura in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Tissamaharamaya, in the District of Hambantota, in the Province of Southern, re-ferred to in Notice No. 83/0074 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1653/20 of 13th May, 2010 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. K. A. K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 11th November, 2016
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
